quiz.q: What did S&P Global do to Poland's credit rating on Nov 6?
options: Kept A- but cut the outlook to negative
quiz.explain: S&P affirmed A- but moved the outlook from stable to negative, citing deficits above 7% of GDP and presidential vetoes.

quiz.q: How many US nonfarm jobs did the BLS report for October 2026?
quiz.explain: Payrolls rose 165,000, well above forecasts, with unemployment at 4.1%. Markets then priced about an 85% chance of a December Fed hike.

quiz.q: What did the Indian Union Cabinet approve for Agniveers this week?
options: An optional two-year Second Tour of Duty
quiz.explain: The Cabinet approved an optional two-year Second Tour of Duty, ahead of the first batch exiting on Nov 21.
